concepts.def: Gavrilo Princip's killing of Archduke Franz Ferdinand on 28 June triggered Austria-Hungary's ultimatum to Serbia.
German strategy to defeat France quickly through Belgium before turning east on Russia; failed at Marne.
British offensive 1 July - 18 November; 60,000 casualties on first day, around 1 million total casualties.
10-month French defence against German attack; symbol of French resistance, around 700,000 total casualties.
Static system of opposing trenches across Western Front; 'no man's land' between, dominated by machine guns and artillery.
Ceasefire signed 11 November in Compiegne forest railway carriage; followed German revolution and Kaiser's abdication.
